purpose: Document city-local registry evidence and schema-first anonymous public geometry review.
assessment: Hubei’s official Natural Resources Department reports that the Jingzhou Real Estate Registration and Transaction Center provides “one certificate, one code, scan to see map” services for the city center; it describes cadastral/rights survey as part of registration and identifies parcel maps and building subdivision plans as registry products. This is city-local registry evidence, but no anonymous, schema-safe parcel vector endpoint was identified. Official Hubei Natural Resources Department coverage describes the Jingzhou center’s QR-coded parcel-map service and cadastral survey workflows. Searches found a property/map visualization candidate but no official public vector API schema with a safe field allowlist; no property identifier was submitted and no map geometry queried.
